observations.limitation: Published measurement summary; no raw samples, percentage drop, or per-location measurements imported.

claims.text: Kyivstar reports a cyberattack interrupting mobile and Internet services on 12 December.
claims.limitation: Operator account. This bundle does not independently establish the attack mechanism.

claims.text: Cloudflare measured a disruption in Kyivstar Internet traffic spanning 12–15 December.
claims.limitation: Observed by Cloudflare, retained as a published summary. Internet traffic is not a direct measurement of voice service.

claims.text: The published disruption interval spans 79 hours 30 minutes.
claims.limitation: Elapsed time between the report’s endpoints; not downtime for every subscriber.

claims.text: Mobile voice restoration began at 18:00 Kyiv time on 13 December.
claims.limitation: A restoration start, not completion. December Kyiv time is UTC+02:00.

claims.text: VEON reports mobile Internet restored across Ukraine on 15 December.
claims.limitation: Customer experience could still vary; no precise restoration time supplied.

claims.text: VEON reports 99% of base stations operational in Ukrainian-government-controlled territory.
claims.limitation: 19 December statement. Not 99% of customers or land area; quality work continued.

claims.text: Kyivstar states subscriber personal data was not compromised.
claims.limitation: An operator statement, not independently verified forensic evidence.

claims.text: The measured traffic disruption is consistent with the operator’s reported service interruption.
claims.limitation: Temporal agreement supports consistency, not independent proof of cause or attribution.

claims.text: The historical Cloudflare report identifies Kyivstar through AS15895.
claims.limitation: One network identifier; this is not a complete inventory of the operator’s infrastructure.

claims.text: The outline provides country-level reference context.
claims.limitation: Natural Earth reference cartography. Not outage extent or December 2023 control lines.
claims.derivation: Select Natural Earth v5.1.2 feature ADM0_A3=UKR.

claims.text: Initial access, affected facilities and independently verified exfiltration remain unresolved in this bundle.
claims.limitation: Missing evidence is not evidence of absence.
